name: dc-bocage_day2-coop-rec
description: Desert Combat Bocage Day 2 co-op with the server-side recorder preloaded, bots only: a DC-made level with DC's own AI data. The AV-8B Harrier, AH-64/Mi-24/UH-60, F-15C/MiG-29/Su-25, T-72/M1A1, BMP-2/M2A3, BRDM-2/Humvee and the TOW and Spandrel cars, M163/Shilka, M-109/M-1974, MLRS and the Scud. Needs `lab.py setup --mods-from-client DesertCombat`.
human: No client needed: the server records itself. Let it play two rounds (each ends on tickets or at the 25-minute limit), then `lab.py stop`.
